title.zh: 将卡林加省 Rizal 市镇的黎刹 国立工艺学校的 Kinama 附属校分离，改设为独立的同名国立中学，并为此拨款
title.en: An Act Separating the Rizal National School of Arts and Trade - Kinama Annex in the Municipality of Rizal, Province of Kalinga From the Rizal National School of Arts and Trade in the Municipality of Rizal and Converting it into a Separate and Independent National High School to be known as the Kinama National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor

text.en: The Rizal National School of Arts and Trade - Kinama Annex in the Municipality of Rizal, Province of Kalinga is hereby separated from the Rizal National School of Arts and Trade in the Municipality of Rizal and converted into a separate and independent national high school to be known as the Kinama National High School.

The school shall offer secondary education proper, as well as secondary science courses to carry out its objectives and as may be authorized by the Secretary of the Department of Education, Culture and Sports.
The Department of Education, Culture and Sports shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
